name: How long do typical wear and tear repairs take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long do typical wear and tear repairs take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of wear and tear repairs varies significantly based on the complexity and scope of the work. Small repairs, such as patching drywall or fixing a leaky faucet, might take a few hours to a day. More extensive projects like repainting an entire room, replacing flooring, or repairing multiple issues across different areas could take several days to a week or more. We provide an estimated timeline with our project proposal so you know what to expect.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair times vary; small fixes take hours to a day, while extensive projects like repainting or flooring replacement can take several days to a week or more.
